notablePrerequisites: At least {3}{R} from sources that ETB untapped.
description:
Cast Heart-Piercer Manticore.
When it ETBs, its trigger goes onto the stack.
In response to the trigger, activate Feldon's ability, making a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
The token copy of Worldgorger Dragon ETBs, exiling all permanents you control.
Resolve the Heart-Piercer Manticore trigger, sacrificing the token copy of Worldgorger Dragon and dealing 7 damage to any target.
The token Worldgorger Dragon's LTB triggers, returning all permanents you control to the battlefield.
Repeat for infinite damage.
